user.title: Crow Media Player
user.description: Adds the Crow Media Player card to your dashboards, and keeps everyone's pins, history and settings in Home Assistant. Choose Configure afterwards for speakers, keys and notifications.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Crow Media Player is already set up.

init.title: Crow Media Player
init.description: Choices for everyone in the house.

data_description.speakers: The speakers whose plays count in Listening Recap, each with its own sensors. Leave empty for every media player. Speakers on any Crow Media Player card are always included.
data_description.tmdb_key: Optional. A TheMovieDB API key or read access token, for film and TV details. Kept in Home Assistant, never sent to phones.
data_description.discogs_token: Optional. A Discogs personal access token, for better album details.
data_description.notify_podcasts: A notification when a podcast someone has pinned has a new episode.
data_description.notify_releases: A notification when an artist the house plays a lot has a new album or single.
data_description.mixes: Playlists made from what the house listens to, in the card's Library under Made for You. They need Music Assistant.
data_description.mix_kinds: On Repeat, Your Month in Music and Forgotten Favourites come from the listening history. The others are chosen by AI.
data_description.mix_day: The day the mixes are made again. Your Month in Music is made on the 1st of each month.
data_description.mix_agent: Optional. The conversation agent that chooses Discover Weekly and the mood mixes. Otherwise Home Assistant's AI Task is used.
data_description.notify_mixes: A notification when new mixes are ready.

start_sleep_timer.name: Start sleep timer
start_sleep_timer.description: Pause a speaker after some minutes, or at the end of the song, turning the volume down gently first and putting it back afterwards.

end_of_track.name: End of this song
end_of_track.description: Pause when the song playing now ends, instead.

volume_entity.name: Volume speaker
volume_entity.description: Turn this speaker's volume down instead (for a group).

cancel_sleep_timer.name: Cancel sleep timer
cancel_sleep_timer.description: Turn off a speaker's sleep timer and put its volume back.

set_alarm.name: Set alarm
set_alarm.description: Wake up to music: at the time, the speaker starts quietly and gets louder over a minute.

days.name: Days
days.description: Which days. Leave empty for once.

media_content_id.name: What to play
media_content_id.description: A playlist, album, station or track (Music Assistant URI or a media ID). Leave empty to carry on with what was last playing.

delete_alarm.name: Delete alarm
delete_alarm.description: Remove an alarm, by its ID or by speaker and time.

entity_id.name: Speaker
entity_id.description: Every alarm on this speaker (or just the one at the time below).

play_station.name: Play a radio station
play_station.description: Play a station by name: one someone has starred in the card, or the best match from Radio Browser.

play_pinned.name: Play something pinned
play_pinned.description: Play a playlist, album, artist, song, station, podcast or audiobook pinned in the card, by its name.

kind.name: Kind
kind.description: Only look at this kind of pin.

mine.name: Only my pins
mine.description: Only the pins of the person running the action.

play_mood.name: Play a mood
play_mood.description: The AI chooses songs for a mood ("a lazy Sunday morning", "dinner party") and Music Assistant plays them.

agent_id.name: Conversation agent
agent_id.description: Optional. Otherwise Home Assistant's AI Task is used.

forget_history.name: Forget listening history
forget_history.description: Delete every play Home Assistant has recorded for Listening Recap.

check_new.name: Check for new episodes and releases
check_new.description: Check now, instead of waiting for the next twice-daily check.

play_mix.name: Play a mix
play_mix.description: Play one of the Made for You mixes, by its name, on a Music Assistant speaker.

name.name: Mix
name.description: The mix's name, like On Repeat or Discover Weekly.

shuffle.name: Shuffle
shuffle.description: Play the songs in a random order.

enqueue.name: Queue
enqueue.description: Play now, play next, or add to the end of the queue.

make_mixes.name: Make mixes now
make_mixes.description: Make the Made for You mixes again now, instead of waiting for the chosen day.

mixes.name: Mixes
mixes.description: Only these mixes. Leave empty for all the ones chosen in Configure.

pause_everywhere.name: Pause everywhere
pause_everywhere.description: Pause every speaker and TV that's playing.

resume.name: Resume
resume.description: Carry on with what a speaker was playing when it stopped (paused, turned off, or lost in a power cut), from where it stopped, at the same volume.
